epic_text:
Epic: User Authentication System
As a platform administrator, I want a secure authentication system so that only authorized users can access the system.

AC1: Users can register with email/password
AC2: Users can log in and receive JWT token
AC3: Token expires after 24 hours
AC4: Rate limiting: max 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes
AC5: Password must meet complexity requirements
prd_text: The authentication system is the foundation of our platform. It must support email+password registration, JWT-based sessions, and brute-force protection. Consider OAuth2 for future phases.
architecture_text: Stack: Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis for rate limiting. Auth module in src/auth/. JWT signing with RS256. Password hashing with bcrypt, cost factor 12.
ux_text: Login page: email field, password field, submit button. Registration page: email, password, confirm password. Show validation errors inline.

epic_text:
Epic: Analytics Dashboard
As a product manager, I want a real-time analytics dashboard so that I can track user engagement metrics.

AC1: Dashboard loads within 2 seconds
AC2: Shows DAU, WAU, MAU charts
AC3: Filterable by date range
AC4: Auto-refresh every 60 seconds
AC5: Export to CSV
prd_text: Dashboard for tracking key product metrics. Must handle 10k+ concurrent users. Data from event stream processed by Kafka → ClickHouse pipeline.
architecture_text: React frontend, WebSocket for real-time updates, ClickHouse for analytics queries, Redis cache for dashboard state.
ux_text: Grid layout with metric cards on top, charts below. Date picker in header. Export button top-right.
